title: Your First Session at the Climbing Centre
transcript:
Welcome to the Riverside Climbing Centre. Before your introductory session begins, please collect a wristband from reception and leave bags in the lockers beside the changing rooms. The colour of your wristband tells instructors which group you belong to. It does not show your level of experience, so please do not move to a different group because you think another colour looks more suitable.

Your instructor will meet you beside the low practice wall. The first part of the session takes place there, where you will learn the centre's basic rules and become familiar with the equipment. Even visitors who have climbed elsewhere must attend this introduction, because the layout and procedures may differ from those they know.

Shoes are included in the session price. Tell a member of staff if a pair feels uncomfortable before the group moves away from reception. We have several sizes available, but changing shoes during the session means missing part of the instruction. Loose jewellery should be placed in your locker rather than handed to an instructor.

Friends who are watching can use the seats behind the marked line. They should keep the space around the practice wall clear, including when taking photographs. At the end of the session, you will have time to ask about future courses. Today's booking does not automatically reserve a place on a longer course, and our reception team can explain the options before you decide.

questions.prompt: What does the colour of a visitor's wristband indicate?
options: Which group the visitor has been assigned to.
Which locker belongs to the visitor.
How long the visitor has been a member.
questions.answer: Which group the visitor has been assigned to.
questions.explanation: 腕带颜色用于区分分组，并不表示经验水平。

questions.prompt: Why must experienced visitors attend the introduction?
options: They are expected to teach other visitors.
The centre may have different procedures and a different layout.
They can only borrow shoes during that period.
Their earlier training records have been lost.
questions.answer: The centre may have different procedures and a different layout.
questions.explanation: 即使有其他场馆经验，也需熟悉本中心不同的布局与流程。

questions.prompt: When should visitors report uncomfortable shoes?
options: When applying for a longer course.
When the instructor begins taking photographs.
questions.explanation: 鞋子不合适应在小组离开前台前提出，避免中途换鞋漏听指导。

questions.prompt: What are friends watching the session asked to do?
options: Stand beside the instructor at the wall.
Hold loose jewellery for every participant.
Reserve places on a future course immediately.
Stay behind the marked line and keep the practice area clear.
questions.answer: Stay behind the marked line and keep the practice area clear.
questions.explanation: 旁观者应在标线后的座位区等候，拍照时也不得占用练习墙周围空间。
